name: GitHub notifications
author: Renaud Hager
description: Unread GitHub notification count in the Omarchy bar, with rules that acknowledge or hide the notifications you never want to see.

barWidget.description: A count of unread GitHub notifications from the gh CLI. Rules auto-acknowledge (mark read on GitHub) or ignore (hide locally) matching threads so the number only reflects what you actually have to look at.

schema.label: Rules (JSON list)
schema.description: A JSON list of {"pattern": ..., "action": "ack" | "ignore"}. The first matching rule wins. Patterns: owner/repo, owner/*, owner/repo#pull, owner/repo#issue, owner/repo#<number>, owner/repo#any, or a bare word matching a repository, subject type (pullRequest, issue, release) or reason (review_requested, assign, comment).
